notes: Follow-ups after a browser task now work the way you say them: “go to Colon repo”, “open it”, “click the second one” or “check my orders” go straight to Saga in the same browser, with the live card under your message. Colon itself decides when to browse (in every mode), reads the page you are on, clears common cookie banners on its own, and Saga no longer ends by asking you to tap something it can do.

browser.notes: Released alongside Colon AI 0.11.5: Saga clears common cookie banners by itself and reads pages more cleanly.
